description: For every relation structure and every natural number \(n\), the shared first-order formula \(P_n(a,b)\) holds exactly when there is a walk of length \(n\) from \(a\) to \(b\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.pathFormula_realize.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.language.Structure M] (n : ℕ) (a b : M) :
  (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.pathFormula n).Realize ![a, b] ↔
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.Walk Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.edge n a b
